title: Holiday event goes live
summary: The first TheySix holiday event opened with Capture the Center gameplay for Java and Bedrock players.
description: After final connectivity work, the holiday event became available with team-based PvP and one-life rules.

body.text: Teams compete to capture and hold the center of the map, with the final successful team taking the win.
The event introduced rules against hacked clients, exploits, outside teaming and spawn camping, with one life per player.
A short launch delay caused by connectivity issues was resolved and the server became available to players.
